# Configuration reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_reference_docs.py — edit the script, not this file -->

Every setting is an environment variable `ADINTEL_<NAME>` (or a line in `.env`). Lists and maps are JSON.
Staging and production refuse to start with development defaults (`config.py::validate_for_environment`).

## Environment and storage

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_ENV` | Literal['local', 'test', 'staging', 'production'] | `local` | Deployment environment: `local`, `test`, `staging`, `production`. Staging/production refuse unsafe defaults at start-up. |
| `ADINTEL_SYSTEM_VERSION` | str | `adintel-0.1.0` | Version string written into reports, audit entries and the footer (defaults to the package version). |
| `ADINTEL_STORAGE` | Literal['memory', 'mongo'] | `memory` | `memory` (exploration, tests) or `mongo` (MongoDB Atlas Local / Atlas). Production requires `mongo`. |
| `ADINTEL_MONGO_URI` | str | `mongodb://localhost:27017/?directConnection=true` | MongoDB connection string. |
| `ADINTEL_MONGO_DB` | str | `adintel` | MongoDB database name. |
| `ADINTEL_VECTOR_SEARCH` | Literal['auto', 'atlas', 'python'] | `auto` | `auto` (Atlas `$vectorSearch` when available, else in-process), `atlas`, or `python` (in-process index). |
| `ADINTEL_QUEUE` | Literal['memory', 'redis', 'sqs'] | `memory` | `memory`, `redis` or `sqs` — job queues between API, worker and executor. |
| `ADINTEL_REDIS_URL` | str | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | Redis connection string (queues, shared rate limits, semantic cache). |
| `ADINTEL_SHARED_STATE` | Literal['memory', 'redis'] | `memory` | `memory` or `redis`: rate limits and semantic cache shared across processes. |
| `ADINTEL_VAR_DIR` | Path | `var` | Local working directory for keys, archives and generated files (`var/`). |
| `ADINTEL_PROMPTS_DIR` | Path | `prompts` | Directory of versioned prompt templates. |

## Models

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_LLM_PROVIDER` | Literal['openai_compat', 'bedrock', 'mock'] | `openai_compat` | `openai_compat` (mlx-lm, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM), `bedrock`, or `mock` (tests only). |
| `ADINTEL_MODELS_CONFIG` | Path | `config/models.yaml` | Path to the model registry (`config/models.yaml`). |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_PROFILE` | str | `mlx` | Local model server profile: `mlx`, `ollama`, `lmstudio`, `llamacpp`, `vllm` (`config/model-profiles.yaml`). |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_PROFILES_CONFIG` | Path | `config/model-profiles.yaml` | Path to the model-server profiles file. |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_SMALL_BASE_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the small/volume tier URL (also feeds report and safety tiers). |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_FRONTIER_BASE_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the frontier/judgement tier URL. |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_REPORT_BASE_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the report tier URL (e.g. a server running with a LoRA adapter). |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_SMALL_ID` | str \| None | — | Override the pinned small-tier model id. |
| `ADINTEL_MODEL_FRONTIER_ID` | str \| None | — | Override the pinned frontier-tier model id. |
| `ADINTEL_REPORT_ADAPTER_PATH` | str \| None | — | LoRA adapter for the report tier (must be signed; see `finetune/`). |
| `ADINTEL_REPORT_ADAPTER_SHA256` | str \| None | — | Pinned SHA-256 of that adapter; a mismatch refuses start-up. |
| `ADINTEL_QWEN_NO_THINK` | bool | `True` | Append Qwen's `/no_think` switch to structured calls (faster, no hidden reasoning). |

## Retrieval, tools and data sources

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_EMBEDDER` | Literal['hashing', 'fastembed'] | `hashing` | `hashing` (offline, deterministic) or `fastembed` (BGE models, needs the `ml` extra). |
| `ADINTEL_RERANKER` | Literal['lexical', 'fastembed'] | `lexical` | `lexical` or `fastembed` (BGE cross-encoder). |
| `ADINTEL_SANDBOX` | Literal['subprocess', 'docker'] | `subprocess` | Analyst code sandbox: `subprocess` or `docker` (network-isolated container). |
| `ADINTEL_CONNECTORS` | Literal['synthetic', 'csv', 'live'] | `synthetic` | Ad data source for every platform: `synthetic`, `csv` (your exports, manual execution) or `live`. |
| `ADINTEL_CONNECTOR_MODES` | dict[str, Literal['synthetic', 'csv', 'live']] | `{}` | Per-platform override as JSON, e.g. `{"google_ads": "live", "meta": "csv"}`. |
| `ADINTEL_CSV_DIR` | Path | `data/import` | Folder for bring-your-own-data CSV exports (`<tenant>/<brand>/<platform>.csv`). |

## Secrets and audit archive

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_SECRETS` | Literal['file', 'aws'] | `file` | `file` (local, encrypted at rest) or `aws` (Secrets Manager). |
| `ADINTEL_SECRETS_DIR` | Path | `secrets` | Local secret store directory. |
| `ADINTEL_SECRETS_REQUIRE_ENCRYPTION` | bool | `False` | Refuse plaintext credential files (use `adintel secrets encrypt`). |
| `ADINTEL_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_DIR` | Path \| None | — | Where write-once audit segments are written (default `var/audit-archive`). |
| `ADINTEL_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_S3_BUCKET` | str \| None | — | S3-compatible bucket with Object Lock for the audit archive (MinIO locally). |
| `ADINTEL_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_S3_ENDPOINT` | str \| None | — | S3 endpoint (MinIO URL locally; unset for AWS). |
| `ADINTEL_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_LOCK_MODE` | Literal['GOVERNANCE', 'COMPLIANCE'] | `GOVERNANCE` | Object Lock mode: `GOVERNANCE` (local) or `COMPLIANCE` (production). |
| `ADINTEL_AUDIT_ARCHIVE_LOCK_DAYS` | int | `2557` | Object Lock retention in days (production: 2557 = 7 years). |

## Identity and sessions

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_AUTH_MODE` | Literal['dev', 'oidc', 'both'] | `dev` | `dev` (local HS256 login), `oidc` (identity provider only — required in staging/production) or `both`. |
| `ADINTEL_DEV_LOGIN_ENABLED` | bool | `True` | Allow the password-less dev login (local/test only; refused elsewhere). |
| `ADINTEL_JWT_SECRET` | str | dev-only default (refused outside local/test) | Signing secret for dev tokens. The development default is refused outside local/test. |
| `ADINTEL_JWT_ISSUER` | str | `adintel-local` | Issuer claim of dev tokens. |
| `ADINTEL_JWT_AUDIENCE` | str | `adintel` | Audience claim of dev tokens. |
| `ADINTEL_JWT_TTL_MINUTES` | int | `480` | Lifetime of dev tokens. |
| `ADINTEL_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES` | int | `30` | Web app signs out after this much inactivity (with a one-minute warning). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_ISSUER` | str | `http://localhost:8180/realms/adintel` | Identity provider issuer URL (Keycloak realm, Okta, Entra ID, Cognito pool). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_AUDIENCE` | str | `adintel-api` | Expected `aud` of access tokens. |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | str | `adintel-frontend` | Public SPA client id used for authorization code + PKCE. |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_JWKS_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the JWKS URL (normally discovered). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_AUTHORIZATION_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the authorization endpoint (normally discovered). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_TOKEN_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the token endpoint (normally discovered). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_END_SESSION_URL` | str \| None | — | Override the logout endpoint — required for Cognito (`https://<domain>/logout`). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_LOGOUT_STYLE` | Literal['rp_initiated', 'cognito'] | `rp_initiated` | `rp_initiated` (standard OIDC) or `cognito`. |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_TENANT_CLAIM` | str | `tenant_id` | Claim holding the tenant id (Cognito: `custom:tenant_id`). |
| `ADINTEL_OIDC_ROLES_CLAIM` | str | `realm_access.roles` | Claim holding roles, dotted path allowed (Keycloak `realm_access.roles`, Cognito `cognito:groups`, Entra `roles`). |

## Governance and signing

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_APPROVAL_SIGNING_KEY` | str | dev-only default (refused outside local/test) | HMAC key signing approval records for the executor. The development default is refused outside local/test. |
| `ADINTEL_REPORT_SIGNING_KEY` | str \| None | — | Ed25519 seed (base64) signing released reports; generated locally, required in staging/production. |
| `ADINTEL_RECOMMENDATION_TTL_HOURS` | int | `72` | How long a recommendation can wait for approval before it expires. |

## Network, API and limits

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_OFFLINE` | bool | `False` | Air-gapped mode: only local/LAN destinations; model downloads and telemetry off. |
| `ADINTEL_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST` | list[str] | `[]` | Hosts (`host`, `host:port`, `*.suffix`) allowed in addition to internal destinations. |
| `ADINTEL_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` | int | `2000000` | Request bodies above this are refused with 413. |
| `ADINTEL_API_DOCS` | bool \| None | — | Expose Swagger/ReDoc/OpenAPI (default: on in local/test, off in staging/production). |
| `ADINTEL_CORS_ORIGINS` | list[str] | `['http://localhost:4200']` | Allowed browser origins for the API (JSON list). |
| `ADINTEL_RUN_MAX_STEPS` | int | `25` | Per-run agent step limit (harness budget). |
| `ADINTEL_RUN_MAX_TOKENS` | int | `400000` | Per-run token limit. |
| `ADINTEL_RUN_MAX_COST_USD` | float | `2.0` | Per-run notional cost limit. |
| `ADINTEL_RUN_MAX_WALL_SECONDS` | float | `900.0` | Per-run wall-clock limit. |
| `ADINTEL_TENANT_DAILY_COST_CAP_USD` | float | `25.0` | Daily AI cost cap per tenant; runs are refused beyond it. |
| `ADINTEL_TENANT_RUNS_PER_MINUTE` | int | `30` | Per-tenant rate limit for runs and API calls. |
| `ADINTEL_SCHEDULE_STAGGER_MINUTES` | int | `90` | Window over which weekly brand runs are spread after 02:00 local time. |

## Observability and alerting

| Variable | Type | Default | Meaning |
|----------|------|---------|---------|
| `ADINTEL_LOG_LEVEL` | str | `INFO` | Log level (`INFO`, `WARNING`, …). |
| `ADINTEL_LOG_JSON` | bool | `True` | Structured JSON logs. |
| `ADINTEL_OTEL_ENDPOINT` | str \| None | — | OpenTelemetry collector (Jaeger locally) for distributed traces. |
| `ADINTEL_LANGFUSE_HOST` | str \| None | — | Langfuse URL for agent/LLM traces. |
| `ADINTEL_LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` | str \| None | — | Langfuse public key. |
| `ADINTEL_LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY` | str \| None | — | Langfuse secret key. |
| `ADINTEL_METRICS_PORT` | int | `9464` | Prometheus metrics port for worker/executor processes. |
| `ADINTEL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL` | str \| None | — | Optional webhook (e.g. Slack) for app-raised alerts. |
| `ADINTEL_ALERT_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` | str \| None | — | Bearer token Alertmanager uses for `/internal/alerts/alertmanager` (≥ 32 random characters in production). |
